scope: Historical six-deck plumbing and transfer pilot. Current Standard integration requires a separate dated engine, vocabulary, reader and exact-deck qualification receipt. No ranked-readiness claim.
microstep_definition: One explicit learner-scored native atomic prefix choice. Auto-forced transitions are unscored environment work, separately reported by native forcedUnique/forcedSingle/decisions/appends/submits. Their seat and expanded choice counts are unavailable; these units are not comparable to historical baseline admitted microsteps. All environment work counts against wall time.

pilot_sequence.accounting: Stage boundaries do not reset the 7200-second or 100000 admitted-learner-choice arm budget. Charge query, collection, optimization, checkpoint, startup and evaluation work. The initial scratch reference is a separately declared control arm. Interleaved evaluation charges each arm its active elapsed work plus shared startup, and retains total invocation wall time.
pilot_sequence.critic_initialization: Ordinary fresh student value head. No teacher-value queries or labels.
pilot_sequence.league: Not implemented in this pilot. An inconclusive playing-strength result does not authorize advancement.

evaluation.uncertainty_unit: 36 independent deck-pair clusters with two seats per cluster; paired differences bounded in [-1,1] and all unresolved outcomes included adversarially
evaluation.assignment: All 36 ordered six-deck pairs, learner in each seat. Initial and transferred checkpoints share the same independent environment and opponent-action seed assignments.
evaluation.opponent: Frozen uniform distribution over the current legal native columns, using an independent seeded action generator. This weak anchor establishes a bounded integration comparison, not competitive strength.
evaluation.selection: Final predeclared update or budget endpoint only; evaluation outcomes do not select checkpoints or tune the training recipe.
evaluation.inference: Teacher-free student policy at declared fixed action-selection mode. Natural outcomes, faults and censoring retained separately.

objective: Full-distribution frozen-Mew policy cross-entropy on queried genuine-choice frames reached by the student. No teacher weight copying, value loss, PPO, outcome policy gradient or changing opponent pool.
completion_evidence: Teacher and student consume the same immutable actor-visible native frame and eligible columns.
Tensor-only teacher scoring preserves native prompt, RNG and statistics; no privileged search-root inputs.
Teacher state and student value-head parameters remain unchanged, while an actual policy update changes student actor parameters.
Checkpoint reload reproduces policy logits, and teacher-free complete-game evaluation includes all scheduled assignments and failures.

Held-out fixed probe reports initial and final target cross-entropy and top-action agreement; complete-game outcomes and uncertainty determine the limited transfer verdict independently of training loss.
runtime: Linux CPU, one intra-op and inter-op thread, eager float32, nice 19. No GPU, live ranked play or cloud spending.
preservation: Freeze actual source and private dependency/checkpoint hashes in bindings before execution. New exclusive output directories only. Keep teacher bundle, weights and raw frames private. Existing comparison artifacts remain immutable.

prelearning_qualification.scope: Actual historical ordered prefix frames and runner forward/reload qualification; no training or Standard claim.
